8-s69.condition: Unit 4, Speaking, упр. 8, с. 69. Расскажи, как ты проводишь свободное время и что обычно делает твой лучший друг.
steps: In my free time I usually meet my friends or play computer games. At the weekend I sometimes visit my grandparents or go shopping with my mum. From time to time I go to the cinema.
My best friend likes sport. He plays football after school and goes swimming twice a week. At weekends we often ride our bikes together.
8-s69.answer: Рассказ о свободном времени: своём и друга (Present Simple, usually / sometimes / often)

9-s69.condition: Unit 4, Speaking, упр. 9, с. 69. В парах обсудите, каких животных люди обычно держат дома.
steps: — Have you got a pet? — I've got a cat. And you?
— I've got a dog. And my friend has got a ferret!
— A ferret? It's a rare pet, isn't it?
— It is. People usually keep cats, dogs, hamsters, budgies and goldfish.
— Yes, they are easy to keep. Ferrets and snakes are unusual pets.
9-s69.answer: Диалог о домашних питомцах: обычные (cats, dogs, hamsters) и необычные (ferrets, snakes)

10-s69.condition: Unit 4, Speaking, упр. 10, с. 69. В парах обсудите, какого питомца можно подарить другу на день рождения.
steps: — Hi! You look puzzled. — I'm thinking about a birthday present for my friend. I'd like to buy him a pet.
— A pet? It's a good present! What does he like?
— He likes birds. — Then buy him a budgie. Budgies are funny and easy to keep.
— Good idea! And a cage and some seeds too.
10-s69.answer: Диалог о подарке-питомце: что любит друг, какой питомец подойдёт

11-s69.condition: Unit 4, Speaking, упр. 11, с. 69. Расскажи, что ты или твои друзья/родственники коллекционируете или хотели бы коллекционировать.
steps: My family and I collect magnets from our travels. A magnet is a good memory of a place. We put them on the fridge. Our collection is quite big — about fifty magnets. My friend collects badges, and my grandfather collects stamps. I'd like to collect coins from different countries.
11-s69.answer: Рассказ о коллекции: что, кто, сколько, почему

12-s70.condition: Unit 4, Speaking, упр. 12, с. 70. Скажи, почему люди ходят в перечисленные места и что они там делают.
steps: People go to museums to see and learn new things. They walk around and look at the exhibits.
People go to the theatre to watch plays, operas and ballets.
People go to picture galleries to look at paintings.
People go to the circus to watch clowns, acrobats and trained animals.
People go to the zoo to see animals from different countries.
12-s70.answer: People go to … to + цель (see, watch, learn, look at)

13-s70.condition: Unit 4, Speaking, упр. 13, с. 70. В ответ на высказывания задай вопросы, чтобы получить дополнительную информацию.

I've got a new pet. — What is it? What's its name? Where do you keep it?
My hobby is collecting stamps. — How many stamps have you got? Which stamp is your favourite?
13-s70.answer: Уточняющие вопросы: Why …? What …? Where …? How many …?

14-s71.condition: Unit 4, Use of English, упр. 14, с. 71. Раздели слова из рамки на четыре категории: питомцы, профессии, места для посещения, хобби.
steps: I) Pets: hamster, puppy, budgie, goldfish, guinea pig, kitten.

III) Places to visit: museum, theatre, circus, picture gallery, zoo.

28-s105.condition: Unit 5, Writing, упр. 28, с. 105. Дополни историю интересными деталями.
steps: Once upon a time there was a little frog. He lived in a lake in the middle of the forest. He was happy and didn't want to change anything. One day a bird told him about the sea. The frog decided to travel. He jumped across the fields, went through the town and at last he saw the sea. It was big and blue. The frog was very glad, but then he came back home — his lake was the best place in the world.

8-s113.condition: Unit 6, Speaking, упр. 8, с. 113. Ответь на вопросы и расскажи о растениях и животных России.
steps: Plant world: The plant world of our country is very rich. There are more than 20 thousand different plants in Russia. Forests are situated in every part of the country: birches, pines, oaks and firs grow there.
Animal world: The animal world is rich too. Bears, wolves, foxes, hares and squirrels live in the forests. Reindeer live in the north, tigers live in the Far East. There are a lot of birds and fish.
8-s113.answer: Два мини-рассказа: растительный и животный мир России

9-s113.condition: Unit 6, Speaking, упр. 9, с. 113. Расскажи о разных регионах России по плану.
steps: The Far East is situated near the Pacific Ocean. The climate is cold in winter and warm in summer. Tigers and bears live there. Vladivostok is the biggest city.
Siberia is a large territory in the centre of Russia. Winters are very cold. There are big rivers and Lake Baikal. Novosibirsk and Irkutsk are big cities.
The South of Russia is warm. There are the Caucasus Mountains and the Black Sea. People grow fruit and vegetables. Sochi is a famous resort.
9-s113.answer: Рассказ о регионе: где расположен, климат, природа, города

10-s114.condition: Unit 6, Speaking, упр. 10, с. 114. A) Прочитай и разыграй диалог. B) Составь свой диалог о поездке в российский город по образцу.
steps: A) Olga: You know, Kate, I'd like to go to Khabarovsk in summer. Kate: Why to this city? Where is it? Olga: It's in the Far East, on the Amur River. It's a big beautiful city.

B) — I would like to go to Irkutsk in summer. — Why? Where is it? — It's one of the biggest cities in Siberia, near Lake Baikal. — What can you see there? — Old churches, museums and, of course, the deepest lake in the world.
10-s114.answer: Диалог о поездке: I'd like to go to … — Why? Where is it? — It's situated in …

11-s114.condition: Unit 6, Speaking, упр. 11, с. 114. Посмотри на карту и расскажи, куда бы ты хотел(а) поехать и почему.
steps: I would like to go to Siberia. It's a very beautiful territory to the east of the Ural Mountains. Siberia is famous for its nature and the deepest lake in the world — Lake Baikal. I'd like to see the taiga and swim in Baikal.
11-s114.answer: I would like to go to … because …

12-s114.condition: Unit 6, Speaking, упр. 12, с. 114. Расскажи, где в России ты хотел(а) бы жить, и объясни почему.
steps: I would like to live in Sochi in the south of Russia. The climate there is very nice: it's hot in summer and warm in winter. I like swimming in the sea and walking in the mountains. There are a lot of parks and the air is fresh.
12-s114.answer: I would like to live in … because the climate / nature / …

13-s114.condition: Unit 6, Speaking, упр. 13, с. 114. Расскажи об Иване Сергеевиче Тургеневе по плану.
steps: Ivan Sergeevich Turgenev was a talented Russian writer. He was born in 1818 in Oryol. His first home was Spasskoye-Lutovinovo, where he spent his childhood. In 1827 he moved to Moscow and later studied at Moscow and St Petersburg universities. He wrote «Fathers and Sons», «A Hunter's Sketches» and «Mumu». He lived a lot in France and died in 1883.
13-s114.answer: Тургенев: родился в 1818, детство в Спасском-Лутовинове, учился в Москве и Петербурге, «Отцы и дети», умер в 1883

14-s115.condition: Unit 6, Use of English, упр. 14, с. 115. A) Напиши, сколько времени у Брайсонов занимает дорога до каждого места. B) Напиши, сколько времени занимает твой путь.
steps: A) It takes the Brysons five minutes to get to the metro station. It takes them fifteen minutes to get to the bus stop. It takes them half an hour to get to the supermarket. It takes them an hour to get to the airport.

B) It takes me 5 minutes to get to the nearest supermarket. It takes me 20 minutes to get to the nearest cinema. It takes me 15 minutes to get to a big bookshop. It takes me 10 minutes to get to school.
14-s115.answer: It takes + кому + время + to get to + место
